name: Novo Nordisk Heritage Experience: Short version
summary:
A single letter in the past created a ripple effect, that gave us the present. What letter will you send to the future?

Journey back in time and experience the founding of Novo Nordisk and the challenges they had to overcome. There are overwhelming amounts of choices out there, but if no-one takes decisions, no innovation can happen for the future.

This is the short 4 minute version of the Heritage Experience.
Optimised for 3x3 meter and best experienced using hand tracking. 
Thanks to the Thomas Fisher R
